title: Quick Ethiopian Duck Fat Sambusa
description: Buttery and silky, this quick-fix Ethiopian dish features duck fat and is suitable for diabetic diets.
instructions: Preheat a tandoor oven or a conventional oven to 425°F (220°C).
Mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, and spice mix in a bowl.
Heat the duck fat in a small pan over medium heat and add the onion mixture; cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped cilantro and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the potato starch to thicken the mixture.
Brush the tandoor bread with the remaining duck fat and place in the preheated oven.
Spoon the onion mixture onto the bread and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the filling is heated through.
Serve the Sambusa immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
